name: local-cache
summary: Manages local OCI image archives to speed repeatable local cluster setup.

lifecycle.idempotency: Validates and replaces only invalid or stale owned cache entries.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before cache mutation when OCI export or digest verification fails.

readiness: Cached OCI archives pass digest and platform validation.

security.secret_storage: No secret value is collected or retained by cache metadata.
security.network_trust: Image pulls follow configured registry trust policy.
security.external_actions: Cache operations are local and do not publish images.
